summary: List the CAs a certificate can be requested at

200.description: The instance CA first, then the CAs an administrator added, by address

preset.description: The preset name of the CA (letsencrypt, letsencrypt-staging, zerossl, google), null for another CA

state.description: The state of the CA's account: none for the instance CA before its first registration

403.description: Not allowed: the user cannot manage certificates

description:
The CAs the certificate create window offers: the instance CA and every CA an administrator set up. Only the address, its preset name and the state of the account are returned.

Needs: certificates Manage
